fato_historico: 1965: At dawn, seven Indonesian Army officers and a police inspector were assassinated by the September 30 Movement at Lubang Buaya, East Jakarta. In addition, two more officers were killed in Yogyakarta. The Army pinned the murders to the Communist Party of Indonesia, resulting in mass killings of suspected leftists.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a reflective stillness, encouraging you to honor the delicate threads of history and healing. As the morning mist clears, consider how even from moments of deep transition and shadows, a beautiful four-leaf clover of hope can emerge. It is a good time to nurture your inner peace and let your gentle intuition guide your path forward with grace.
frase_do_dia: Gentleness is the greatest strength you can offer the world today.
significado_numero: Represents spiritual wisdom and the seeking of inner truth.
conselho: Trust your dreams and embrace the quiet magic of new beginnings.
